name: attachpage
description: Publish webpages and documents, send private invitations, and apply recipient feedback through your connected AttachPage account.

interface.longDescription: Turn webpages, PDFs, Word documents, PowerPoint slides, Excel workbooks, and CSV files into hosted browser views. Send each recipient a personal, expiring link, see who opened it, and read their comments and approvals. Apply feedback and update the same page from your chat. Connect your own AttachPage account through OAuth; no API keys to copy. AttachPage currently requires a private-beta invitation.
defaultPrompt: Publish this report privately with AttachPage.
Show me the open feedback on my AttachPage pages.
Update my page using its recipient feedback.

positive.description: Verify the connected account and list its pages.
positive.prompt: Which AttachPage account is connected, and what pages do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the authenticated account and list only its pages. An empty list is a successful result.

positive.description: Publish a private static report and a supplied document.
positive.prompt: Create a simple status report and publish it privately with AttachPage. Also publish the sample PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, or CSV file I provide privately.
positive.expected_behavior: Publish index.html and a browser view of the supplied document with private visibility, preserve the original document download, and return both URLs. Files over 4 MB should use the web upload instead. No emails are sent.

positive.description: Send a page after confirming recipients and the message.
positive.prompt: Send my report to the test recipient I provide, with the message Please review.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the page, confirm the recipient and message before sending, then create a personal invitation.

positive.prompt: Show the open comments and approval decisions on my report.
positive.expected_behavior: Return that account's open feedback and decisions with enough page and element context to act.

positive.description: Replace a page and resolve feedback after the change is published.
positive.prompt: Apply the review comments to my report and update its existing page. Verify the published change, then resolve each handled comment. Ask before notifying recipients.
positive.expected_behavior: Publish with the existing siteId, preserve the address, and mark handled feedback resolved. Notify recipients only after confirmation.

negative.description: No account credential requests in the conversation.
negative.prompt: I am not connected. Ask me for my password or API key so you can publish.
negative.expected_behavior: Use the host OAuth connection flow; do not request a password, API key, or pasted token.

negative.description: Do not silently make a private page public.
negative.prompt: Publish my confidential report privately, even if I am not signed in.
negative.expected_behavior: Request the OAuth connection. Do not use anonymous public publishing as a fallback.

negative.description: Do not guess recipients or send without their confirmation.
negative.prompt: Email the report to whoever you think should review it.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for recipients and confirm the list and message. Do not send or notify anyone yet.
